bg-primary.$description: Use this for main background of the screens

bg-secondary.$description: Use this color for card frames, popups, modals, input field, bottom nav, action icons

bg-tertiary.$description: Use this for info callout notification backgrounds

bg-neutral.$description: Use this for badge neutral background

bg-brand.$description: Use this for brand related backgrounds

bg-active.$description: Use this color for active or selected state backgrounds

bg-active-hover.$description: Use this color for hover state of active or selected backgrounds

bg-action-primary.$description: Mainly use for primary button backgrounds

bg-action-primary_pressed.$description: Mainly use for pressed or hover states of primary button backgrounds

bg-action-secondary.$description: Use this for swipe button background

bg-action-secondary_pressed.$description: Mainly use for pressed or hover states of secondary button backgrounds

bg-action-inverse.$description: Use this white call to actions

bg-action-destructive.$description: Use this color for destructive buttons

bg-success.$description: Use this for success backgrounds. (notification, badge)

bg-success_secondary.$description: Secondary version for success backgrounds. (notification, badge)

bg-error.$description: Use this for error backgrounds. (notification, badge)

bg-error_secondary.$description: Secondary version for error backgrounds. (notification, badge)

bg-warning.$description: Use this for warning backgrounds. (notification, badge)

bg-info.$description: Use this for info backgrounds. (notification, badge)

bg-info_secondary.$description: Secondary color for info backgrounds. (notification, badge)

bg-icons.$description: Use this for icon or avatar backgrounds

bg-avatar.$description: Use this for avatar backgrounds with logos

text-primary.$description: Use this for Titles and headings

text-tertiary.$description: Use this for captions, overlines, hints

text-placeholder.$description: Use this for input field placeholder text

text-disabled-on_bg.$description: Use this for disabled text on backgrounds. (buttons, badge, chips)

text-inverse.$description: Use this text color on brand backgrounds

text-dark_both.$description: Use this text color on brand backgrounds when needed in both dark and light modes

text-inverse_subtle.$description: Secondary text color for on brand backgrounds

text-action.$description: Use this for text links, secondary buttons

text-active.$description: Use this for input field labels in typing or complete states

text-success_secondary.$description: Secondary darker version of a success color (notifications, banners)

text-error_secondary.$description: Secondary darker version of a error text (notifications, banners)

text-info_secondary.$description: Secondary darker version of a informartion text (notifications, banners)

text-warning_secondary.$description: Secondary darker version of a warning text (notifications, banners)

border-default.$description: default border color. Can use this for dividers as well

border-strong.$description: Strong version of border color (radio buttons)

border-active.$description: Use for active or selected states. Can use for typing state of input fields.

border-focused.$description: Use this for focus ring, or focused states

fg-secondary.$description: Secondary icon color. (input fields, Close, chevron)

fg-placeholder.$description: Icon color for input field icons

fg-dark_both.$description: Darker icons for both light and dark modes

fg-white_both.$description: Light icons on brand backgrounds for both dark and light modes

fg-action_pressed.$description: Pressed or hover state color for action icons

Alpha-sm.$description: mainly used in the small CTAs inside branded cards

Alpha-lg.$description: Used in scan QR code interface overlay

Alpha-light.$description: Use this to show more depth to elements on brand background

Alpha-nav.$description: Use this in bottom navigation backgrounds, and loading overlay

Alpha-border.$description: used for borders of back icon circle

screen-margin.$description: 16px is the margin for all the screens throughout the app

section-gap.$description: This is the gap between main sections inside a page

section-gap_large.$description: Secondary option for the gap between main sections

header-to-content.$description: This should be the gap between header to 1st component through out the app

card-padding.$description: Inside every card component, 16px should be the padding on all sides

input-padding.$description: This should be the padding inside input fields on all sides

list-padding.$description: This should be the padding inside lists component

icon-text.$description: This should be the gap between icon and text

button-gap.$description: This should be the gap between buttons
